trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The Platinum unlocks automatically once you have earned the other 54 trophies, so there is no separate task to complete for it. Everything on the list is single-player, with no online, difficulty, or mission-medal requirements, and the whole list can be done in one playthrough. Guides put the total at around 200 hours, with most of that time going to the 100% completion checklist behind A Long Road. Follow the roadmap in this file stage by stage, keep a manual save at the start of every chapter, and never use cheats on your trophy save, since they are expected to disable trophies and saving.
steps: Play through the story and finish all side content, activities, and collectibles.
Complete the 100% checklist to earn A Long Road.
Check the trophy list for any stragglers, then mop them up in free roam.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion on the game's 35-task checklist, which appears under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion once the story is done. Work you did before the credits still counts, and nothing on the checklist is missable. The list does not demand everything: some lines need full completion, such as all 8 bank vaults, all 39 gang operations, every shooting range gold medal, all drone races, and Bret's 15 Target Decks, while others ask for only a share, such as 15 of 18 card sets, 200 of 277 vehicle scans, 100 of 255 animal studies, 15 of 18 meditations, 70 of 80 challenges, and 300 stunts. This is the longest single trophy, roughly 100 hours of the Platinum's estimated 200, so chip away at its lines throughout the game rather than leaving them all for the end.
steps: Finish the story, then open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion to see the 35-task checklist.
Work through the checklist lines, starting with the ones that need full completion.
Use the in-game progress trackers to find whatever is left, then finish it in free roam.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missable_note: The Chapter 1 balcony meditation at Jason's house disappears after Chapter 1 ends. Do it (morning after Down to Earth, follow Lucia from the kitchen to the balcony and accept) and keep a Chapter 1 manual save until this trophy pops. It is not confirmed whether the trophy strictly needs that spot, but no guide has proven it can be earned without it.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every meditation spot until the counter reaches 18, across 10 spot locations. Spots show as purple icons when you are close, and meditating at a spot with both Jason and Lucia together counts twice, so bring your partner each time. The first meditation is the one to be careful with: in Chapter 1, the morning after the mission Down to Earth, check the kitchen, follow Lucia out to the balcony of Jason's house, and accept her invitation to meditate — it is gone once Chapter 1 ends. The last spot needs both characters, which is possible after Coffee Break in Chapter 2, and the final location, Ascent Mountain in Lummox County, is only marked on the map after the others are done. Track progress under Progress, then Collections, then Exploration, then Meditations. The 100% checklist only asks for 15 of 18, so this trophy needs the full set.
steps: In Chapter 1, the morning after Down to Earth, follow Lucia to the balcony and accept her meditation.
Meditate at each purple-icon spot with both characters once switching is available.
Finish the final spot, Ascent Mountain in Lummox County, to reach 18 meditations.

The haul is too heavy for one character, so hand a bag to your partner. Vault jobs give you a 4-star Wanted Level straight away, so escape on a fast bike and then switch vehicles; escaping one with your partner also earns Hot Together. Five of the eight vaults are enough for this trophy, but the 100% checklist needs all eight, and each vault pays up to $205,000. Yasmani sells van tips for $10,000 if you need a lead.
steps: Complete the optional Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is.
Tail a security van to a bank and enter the vault while it is open.
Bring your partner to carry the haul, then escape the 4-star heat.
Repeat until you have robbed 5 bank vaults.

roadmap.title: Story Playthrough
roadmap.summary: Play through the five chapters and all story missions, from Gone Fishing to the final mission. Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter and one untouched save from just before the final mission — there is no mission replay or New Game Plus. The one thing you must not skip: in Chapter 1, the morning after Down to Earth, follow Lucia to the balcony and accept her meditation, since it feeds the possibly missable Positive Mental Attitude.

roadmap.title: Side Content and Strangers
roadmap.summary: Finish the side-character questlines (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret) and eight Strangers & Freaks strands — do Yago's timed Chapter 3 race as soon as it appears. Then clear the partner trophies, the robbery trophies (jewelry stores, armored trucks, gang operations, Kingpin Bowling), the one-off hidden trophies (jet, tank, Combat Focus, gym, Criminal Profile), and the fishing and arcade trophies. Everything here stays available after the story.

roadmap.title: Collectibles and Exploration Cleanup
roadmap.summary: Work through the big counts: 250 stunts (300 for 100%), all 42 shooting range gold medals, drone race wins at all 14 locations, 20 different race wins, 3 card sets, 100 WAiNK scans, 50 challenges, 100 discovered vehicles, the full map fog cleared, 5 bank vaults, $250,000 laundered, $100,000 spent, all 8 garages, and 10 Scooter Bros registrations. Most of these feed the 100% checklist, so push past each trophy's target toward the checklist's higher thresholds.

roadmap.title: Grind and Final Mop-Up
roadmap.summary: Open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion and finish the remaining lines of the 35-task checklist — the longest stretch of the Platinum, roughly 100 hours. Once A Long Road pops, check the trophy list for any stragglers, clean them up in free roam, and Vice Got a Price! unlocks.
